definition: An umbrella term for practices and principles aimed at ensuring AI systems are developed and used ethically, safely, and beneficially.
details: Responsible AI encompasses fairness, transparency, privacy, safety, and accountability considerations throughout the AI development lifecycle, from data collection through deployment and monitoring.
story: Imagine a new medicine that works brilliantly in the lab but still has to be tested on real people before anyone takes it. In plain words: An umbrella term for practices and principles aimed at ensuring AI systems are developed and used ethically, safely, and beneficially. Here is how it actually plays out: Responsible AI encompasses fairness, transparency, privacy, safety, and accountability considerations throughout the AI development lifecycle, from data collection through deployment and monitoring. Rules and red-teaming are the brakes that make the speed trustworthy. That deliberate caution is Responsible AI.
